  FROM artifacts
),

    GROUP_CONCAT(accession_number || ',' || title || ',' || copies || ',' || location || ',' || COALESCE(notes, '')) as csv_rows
  FROM (SELECT accession_number, title, copies, location, notes FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY accession_number)
)

args.query:
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT artifact_id, accession_number, title, copies, location, notes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accession_number ORDER BY artifact_id) as rn
  FROM artifacts
),
csv_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    'accession_number,title,copies,location,notes' || 
    CHAR(10) || 
    GROUP_CONCAT(accession_number || ',' || title || ',' || copies || ',' || location || ',' || COALESCE(replace(replace(notes, ',', ';'), CHAR(10), ''), '') 
    , ',') as csv_content
  FROM (SELECT accession_number, title, copies, location, notes FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY accession_number)
)
SELECT csv_content FROM csv_rows;

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT artifact_id, accession_number, title, copies, location, notes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accession_number ORDER BY artifact_id) as rn
  FROM artifacts
)
SELECT 
  'accession_number,title,copies,location,notes' || 
  CHAR(10) || 
  GROUP_CONCAT(accession_number || ',' || title || ',' || copies || ',' || location || ',' || COALESCE(replace(replace(replace(notes, ',', ';'), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), ''), '')) || 
  CHAR(10) as payload
FROM (SELECT accession_number, title, copies, location, notes FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY accession_number)
HAVING GROUP_CONCAT(accession_number || ',' || title || ',' || copies || ',' || location || ',' || COALESCE(replace(replace(replace(notes, ',', ';'), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), ''), '')) IS NOT NULL;

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT artifact_id, accession_number, title, copies, location, notes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY accession_number ORDER BY artifact_id) as rn
  FROM artifacts
),
csv_payload AS (
  SELECT 
    'accession_number,title,copies,location,notes' ||

    GROUP_CONCAT(accession_number || ',' || title || ',' || copies || ',' || location || ',' || COALESCE(replace(replace(replace(notes, ',', ';'), CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), ''), '')) || 
    CHAR(10) as payload
  FROM (SELECT accession_number, title, copies, location, notes FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY accession_number)
)
